tool_args.rationale: The three-coefficient subcritical law fits all ten paid rows with training RMSE about 1.5e-8. Submit it for fresh confirmation at H = 0.6. Predictions above the sampled gradient range are extrapolations; the training fit does not validate the proposed avalanche branch.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All paid observations have s_grad <= 2.35, below the proposed onset range of 2.50–2.68. The onset and penalty strength cannot be fitted from these rows.

considered_alternatives.option: Haldane inhibition or Cobb–Douglas power law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Haldane omits gradient dependence, while Cobb–Douglas uses a power-law input response instead of the saturating term plus square-root contribution that fits all ten observations to rounding precision.
Both probes have already been acquired without sampling above the proposed onset. No remaining targeted probe is listed.
